q: Why is a visible, editable plan valuable?
options: It is the cheapest place to catch a misunderstanding, before work starts
explain: Correcting a plan costs seconds; correcting finished work costs minutes or hours.

q: What should a good progress stream show?
options: Readable steps, what each found, and problems as they appear
explain: Summarized activity builds trust; raw monologue is noise.

q: Why put the work product in an artifact pane?
options: Users can edit it directly instead of describing edits in chat
explain: Direct editing is faster and clearer than chat instructions.
